summary: All twelve tracked projects currently carry a needs-attention verdict. Open actions fell 758 to 662 this week, the strongest net weekly closure since tracking began, and four projects (Cattery, Apothecary, Budget, Scheduler) shipped real fixes in the last 48 hours their own dashboards have not caught up to yet. The Gnosis BLOCK is open a second consecutive week and now actively validated by the release pipeline instead of merely unchecked, and Tuesday's bar-raise slot (Chains, Budget) has gone dark for 12 days.

Restore the Tuesday bar-raise slot; Chains and Budget have had no per-project review in 12 days.
Re-verify the Stripe Billing Portal userId-trust bug on handleBillingCheckout/handleBillingPortal; last confirmed 12 days ago.
Re-verify bulk-delete/merge-merchant/Plaid-sync still bypass the pre-operation backup step; last confirmed 12 days ago.
Redact the live Chains exploit detail and Skylight credential language still shipping in the public Pages artifact.
Fix the unauthenticated Worker writes flowing unescaped into innerHTML and the three disconnected pause authorities.
Surface pgStateWrite's discarded failure result and fix mergeStates() wholesale-replace behavior.
Correct the public mirror page still describing a live, months-old Stripe Connect escrow product as 'In build, no payments'.
Force the Hordes/Scheduler/Budget build-vs-park decisions; none of the three project reports can force this alone.
Run a fresh bar-raise to confirm v0.25.6 actually closes the nine findings chronic since 2026-07-08.
